claims.sentence: As an applicant, your exam results will be published on the official website within 3 working days after the day of the exam
The results will be published no later than 1 day before the publication of the competitive lists
As an applicant, you must submit your appeal on the day the results are announced or within the next working day
If your appeal concerns a violation of the established procedure for conducting the exam, you may also submit it on the day of the exam
You can submit the appeal in person or by sending it to the email address `айт!5510п5 @ ппоро!!5.ги`
The appeal will be reviewed no later than the next working day after the day you submit it
As an applicant, you have the right to be present during the review of your appeal
After the review, the appeal commission will decide to change your exam score or leave it unchanged
The commission's decision, formalized in a protocol, will be communicated to you
Your acknowledgment of the decision is recorded by your signature if you are present in person, or by an email sent to your personal email address from `аат\!$5510п5@ ппоро!!5.ги. \!`
The procedure also references lists of applicants who filed appeals and competitive lists
The evidence does not specify the consequences of missing the appeal submission deadline
It does not state the required format, content, or supporting documents for an appeal
The evidence cuts off while mentioning lists of applicants who filed appeals and competitive lists, leaving the subsequent steps undefined
The email addresses in the evidence contain OCR artifacts and their functionality is unverified
The evidence does not specify the timeframe for acknowledging the commission's decision
It does not detail the composition of the appeal commission or the specific criteria for score changes
The evidence does not address how results are published if the 3-day or 1-day limits conflict with other university schedules
The regulation does not reference course pages, so any course-specific instructions cannot be cross-checked against this document
